evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature reads ~374 °C and climbs monotonically to ~381.5 °C, physically implausible versus column temps of 58-76 °C at 400 mbar; suggests sensor fault/drift rather than real boil-up
All column temperatures essentially flat over 20 min (T712 ~58.2 °C, T702 ~75.8 °C), no separation front development
Reflux flow near zero and erratic (0.01-0.16 L/h) while FT704 distillate ~0.5 L/h, so FYI702 reported ratio 2.7-3.9 is inconsistent with measured flows

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature check (or reboiler duty/jacket reading) and a reflux-flow verification to confirm whether T701 and FT703/FYI702 are sensor faults versus a true process condition; plus a distillate composition sample.
